title: how to make an event jump to specific X Y coordinates RMMZ

posts.author: Bwest09
posts.body:
How can I make an event jump to a certain x y location.
For example Jump - ID:004  to position X:26 Y:11
I know set event location works but, i want the event to jump not teleport.
I'm hoping there is a script of some sort.
Thanks

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
By default you can't do that.
You can try one of these two plugins:
Hakuen Studio Jump System for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
A jump system with flexible conditions for enable/disable the jump!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
Or this one:
MZ Move Route Extras
FEATURES This plugin adds script commands you can use in ‘Move Routes’ that enable you to do extra things during autonomous and forced movement such as: – jump forward x spaces – jump to an event o…
galvs-scripts.com
Can also take a look at this thread if you want to use script call instead of plugins:
MZ - Jump designation with variables
Hello, It's possible in “transfer player” to use designation with variables, and for jump no…   It's possible to do this in javascript? (I don't find a thread in this topic)
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
